newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy sets 14.0 trillion lire repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy sets 14.0 trillion lire repo tender.

text.p: The Bank of Italy said it called a 14.0 trillion lire repurchase tender for today or tomorrow for government securities to be resold on January 2, 1997.
At the previous comparable operation for 5.0 trillion lire on November 28, the minimum accepted rate stood at 8.01 percent and the average rate at 8.03 percent.
The Bank of Italy also noted that new regulations on taxation would apply for coupons maturing January 1, 1997 and onwards with abolition of witholding tax at source for non residents.
